term: one world's capacity for every prefix
definition: A single finite-capacity model world would have to accommodate every natural-number-sized prefix, rather than choosing a new capacity world for each prefix.
note: The single-world quantifier has different scope from per-prefix existence. Transferring this model to real metaphysical possibility requires an independently defended modal interpretation.
